title: Unnamed bridges (west of Iol Caesarea)
description: A pair of bridges located west of Iol Caesarea, spanning the Oued el Kantara and Oued Rassoul (marked with one symbol on BAtlas).

properties.description: Single symbol used on BAtlas for two bridges. Feature extracted using QGIS (2025) from raster image of BAtlas Map 30 created and georegistered to the original base map projection by the Ancient World Mapping Center in 2002. Dates after BAtlDir.
